captions.text:
TINY FICTION:
THE SEA HIRED A QUIET
WAVE.

ON DAY ONE, IT ASKED:
'WHAT IS MY JOB?'

'SHOW UP, FALL APART,
AND DO IT AGAIN.'

THE WAVE ASKED IF THIS
WAS AN OFFICE JOB.
